function.name: findings.Export
function.description: Export a finding, evidence artifact, report or stored scan artifact into the sandbox. Returns a sandbox-relative path, hash and size.

id.description: Finding ID for "finding" and "evidence", or scan ID for "scan".

path.description: Optional sandbox-relative destination path, e.g. "./work/evidence.txt". Defaults to a path under ./work.

function.name: findings.Import
function.description: Import scanner output as candidate findings. Currently supports nuclei JSONL. The artifact is read from inside the sandbox; raw scanner content is never returned.

path.description: Path to a nuclei JSONL artifact inside the sandbox, e.g. "./work/scans/scan-123-nuclei.jsonl".

scan_id.description: Optional scan identifier. Defaults to a hash of the artifact content.

command.description: Optional command line that produced the artifact. Stored on imported evidence.

function.name: findings.Add
function.description: Create a candidate finding. Add evidence with findings.BindEvidence and prove it with findings.Verify or findings.Retest.

title.description: Short finding title, e.g. "Authentication bypass on admin API".

asset_ids.description: Optional asset identifiers affected by the finding.

endpoint.description: Optional target endpoint, URL or host.

parameter.description: Optional vulnerable parameter or input name.

preconditions.description: Optional setup required to reproduce the finding.

counterevidence.description: Optional evidence or observations that contradict the finding.

source_scan_id.description: Optional scan identifier that produced this candidate.

function.name: findings.List
function.description: List findings with compact summaries, newest and most severe first.

limit.description: Maximum number of findings to return. Defaults to 50.

function.name: findings.Search
function.description: Search findings across titles, endpoints, parameters, reproduction text and evidence.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 50.

function.name: findings.Get
function.description: Return one finding as structured JSON, including evidence metadata and hashes. Internal storage paths are not returned; use findings.Export to materialize evidence.

function.name: findings.Update
function.description: Update descriptive finding fields. Status and evidence must be changed with findings.Retest, findings.Verify or findings.BindEvidence.

function.name: findings.BindEvidence
function.description: Attach evidence to a finding. Provide exactly one of content or artifact. Content is redacted and hashed; artifact is copied from the sandbox and hashed.

source.description: Optional source tool, program or agent.

command.description: Optional command used to produce the evidence.

exit_code.description: Optional command or test exit code.

environment.description: Optional environment variables required to reproduce.

content.description: Inline evidence content. Secrets are redacted and content is capped.

artifact.description: Path to an existing file inside the sandbox, e.g. "./findings/fnd_4a91c2e0/proof_test.go".

content_type.description: Optional MIME type for the evidence artifact.

function.name: findings.Verify
function.description: Mark a finding as verified. Requires executed_live or executed_lab proof and at least one evidence entry. Use require_reproduction for a Go unit test or PoC plus a successful test run.

evidence.description: Optional evidence object using the same fields as findings.BindEvidence.

require_reproduction.description: Require a unit_test or poc artifact, a successful test_run, and environment or preconditions.

function.name: findings.Retest
function.description: Change a finding status after a retest, optionally attaching new evidence or counterevidence.

evidence.description: Optional new evidence object using the same fields as findings.BindEvidence.

counterevidence.description: Optional evidence that the finding is fixed or false.

function.name: findings.Report
function.description: Generate a Markdown findings report and return its content and finding count. Use findings.Export with type "report" to write it into the sandbox.
